subject: Drifting Hazard - Strait of Georgia
text:
Drifting Hazard - Strait of Georgia
Floating structure adrift in Baynes Sound in the vicinity of 49 29.730N 124 46.733W. The structure is reported as approximately 80ft square, 2 stories tall with a green rooftop, brown siding and is drifting Northward.
 
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1543-26
